summary:
**TerraShift AI – Smart Crop Rotation Using NASA Earth Observation Data**

TerraShift AI is a farm decision-support prototype designed to help farmers make informed crop rotation decisions using environmental data and local farm information. We developed a web-based dashboard using React.js, a Python FastAPI backend, and NASA POWER data services.

Farmers can enter their location, latitude, longitude, soil type, current crop, water availability, and farming priority. The system retrieves rainfall and temperature information through the NASA POWER API, displays climate indicators and charts, and compares three crop rotation strategies. Each strategy includes a suitability score, water requirements, soil benefits, reasons, and potential risks. A clearly labelled simulated demo-data option is also available.

Our project addresses challenges such as changing rainfall patterns, limited water availability, and declining soil health. It is important because it makes environmental information easier to understand and helps farmers explore more sustainable, climate-resilient farming choices.
details:
Project Details – TerraShift AI

TerraShift AI is an AI-powered agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers make smarter and more sustainable farming decisions. It focuses on improving soil health, recommending suitable crops, and supporting better crop rotation practices.

What does it do and how does it work?

TerraShift AI analyzes agricultural information and helps identify suitable crops and crop rotation strategies. It provides intelligent recommendations to help farmers improve soil fertility, reduce soil degradation, and make better use of available agricultural resources.

What are its benefits?

  • Helps farmers choose suitable crops.
  • Encourages sustainable crop rotation.
  • Supports soil health and long-term soil fertility.
  • Reduces the risk of continuous monocropping.
  • Helps farmers make informed agricultural decisions.
  • Promotes efficient and environmentally friendly farming.

Intended impact

Our project's main goal is to support sustainable agriculture, protect soil resources, improve farming practices, and contribute to long-term food security. We aim to make AI-based agricultural guidance more accessible and useful for farmers.

Tools and technologies used

We developed the prototype using:

  • Python – Backend programming.
  • FastAPI – Building backend APIs.
  • Uvicorn – Running the backend server.
  • HTML, CSS and JavaScript – Frontend development.
  • AI-based logic – Supporting intelligent agricultural recommendations.
  • Visual Studio Code – Development environment.

What makes the project creative?

TerraShift AI combines artificial intelligence with sustainable agriculture. Instead of focusing only on crop selection, it also emphasizes crop rotation and soil conservation, connecting immediate farming decisions with long-term environmental sustainability.

Factors considered by our team

  • Soil health and fertility.
  • Crop suitability and rotation.
  • Sustainable farming practices.
  • Environmental impact.
  • Ease of use and accessibility.
  • Practical usefulness for farmers.
  • Future scalability and improvements.

TerraShift AI aims to turn agricultural information into practical insights, helping farmers make smarter decisions while protecting the land for future generations.
